| 1. | Any fireplace specially designed or adapted for combustion of liquid fuel and equipped with mechanical stokers. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | The fuel for which the mechanical stoker was designed. |
| 2. | Any fireplace (other than a fireplace fired by pulverised fuel) constructed on or after 31st December 1956 and installed before 28th April 1982 and equipped with mechanical stokers, or adapted between those dates for use with such stokers. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | The fuel for which the mechanical stoker was designed. |
